name: qlrisk_price_uk_gilt
title: Price a UKGilt
description:
Price one UK Gilt (qlrisk UKGilt).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, face_value=100, coupon_pct*, frequency=semi-annual, currency=GBP. In `advanced` also: effective_date, issuer, position.
Example: {"maturity": "5Y", "face_value": 100, "coupon_pct": 5} gives NPV 103.14 GBP (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
